messages:
Sara (Marketing): Quick heads-up — we need a compact "benchmark storyboard" + webinar POV for enterprise launch next Tue. Focus: security controls, SLA guarantees, and deploy-mode decisioning (hosted / dedicated / private). I want something we can hand to SDRs and to engineering for benchmarks. Who can own the micro-brief and the webinar slide outline?

Mike P. (PMM): I can draft the messaging + hero stat. Suggest hero stat: "99.95% SLA across dedicated pools — tuned for enterprise throughput" but want validation from eng. Will draft 1-pager copy + 3-slide webinar outline.

Dan S. (Solutions): I’ll handle the deploy-mode decision frames and quick runbook for the webinar demo. Can also provide one benchmark table comparing p95 latency and cost/unit for hosted vs dedicated vs private. Need the latest numbers from infra.

Ana G. (Growth): I’ll own inbound routing & CTA mapping. Proposal: tag inbound leads with [enterprise-security], [sla-priority], [private-deploy] and route to Sales/Field Ops via lead matrix. Will sketch routing rules and required metadata fields.

Leo (Design): I’ll mock the micro-brief layout and webinar hero slide. Will keep to a single page (two-column) for print and a deck-friendly hero slide. Need optimized copy from Mike.

Sara (Marketing): Great. Rough timeline: Mike + Dan have drafts by EOD Thurs, Leo has mock by Fri noon, Ana builds routing matrix by Fri EOD. Webinar dry-run Monday. Is that doable?

Mike P. (PMM): EOD Thurs sounds tight but OK. Will drop a short copy deck with 3 headline variants for testing:
- Variant A: "Secure, predictable LLM inference — SLAs you can trust"
- Variant B: "Ship LLM features with enterprise SLAs and private deployment"
- Variant C: "Control cost, latency, and compliance across deployments"

Dan S. (Solutions): Need the infra numbers. @ops-bot can you attach last week's benchmark artifacts (p95, p99, cost tokens) for hosted/dedicated/private? Also which model family did we benchmark (LlamaX-70B quantized)?

ops-bot: Attached: infra_bench_2026_03_15.csv; model: LlamaX-70B-q4; metrics: p50/p95/p99, tokens/s, GPU util, cost-per-1k-tokens.

Ana G. (Growth): Draft routing rule (first pass):
```
if lead.tags contains "enterprise-security" -> route_to: field_sales_enterprise
elif lead.tags contains "sla-priority" and lead.company_size >= 1000 -> route_to: solutions_engineering
elif lead.tags contains "private-deploy" and lead.region == "eu" -> route_to: sales_eu_private
else -> route_to: inbound_growth_queue
```
Will export as CSV for SDR system. Also propose email subject lines for webinar invites: "Enterprise inference: SLAs, security, and deployment tradeoffs" and "Benchmarking inference costs and latency for production apps"

Leo (Design): Mock uploaded to #shared-assets as /marketing/bench-hero-v1.png. Kept hero stat slot open for Mike's final wording. Clean, enterprise-feel.

Sara (Marketing): Nice. Two quick asks: 1) Mike — pick hero stat from Dan's validated numbers (we should avoid rounding that overpromises). 2) Ana — add required lead fields in the CSV (tag, company_size, region, initial_request_text) so SDRs get context.

Mike P. (PMM): Will pull the p95 numbers and propose three hero-stat options with exact figures. Also will prepare 2 short social post captions for launch (X / LinkedIn) + one webinar landing blurp.

Dan S. (Solutions): I'll validate numbers by tomorrow morning and add a short footnote for test setup (model, seq len, GPU type). Also will prepare the demo script for the webinar (5-min litmus test + failover demo).

Ana G. (Growth): Routing CSV schema: tag,company_size,region,contact_email,lead_source,initial_request_text,route_to. I'll post sample CSV to the thread tonight.

Sara (Marketing): Perfect. I'll coordinate the dry-run schedule. One more thing — messaging angle: emphasize "unified serving across environments" as a differentiator vs "single-endpoint" competitors. Keep compliance language tight for legal review.

Mike P. (PMM): Noted. Will avoid legal claims and run copy by security/legal. +1 on unified-serving angle.

Leo (Design): Updated mock with unified-serving badge and security iconography.

Sara (Marketing): Thanks all. If anyone hits blockers ping here and drop the doc links. :rocket:
